thread:
rita: Quick sync on rollout approach for `micro-surge` feature flag. Goal: protect latency-sensitive customers while validating cost and quality tradeoffs. Thoughts: micro-canary staircase + tenant veto + automated shed layers.
sam: +1. Proposed staircase: shadow 48h -> 0.5% internal -> 2% beta tenants -> 10% regional -> 50% global. Each step gated by latency, error, and cost deltas.
josh: For gates, use three signals: (1) p95 latency delta vs baseline > 30% AND p95 > 300ms, (2) error_rate > 0.8%, (3) cost_per_1000 > baseline + 15%. Any single signal sustained for 2 consecutive 5m windows triggers rollback.
sales-liaison: We need tenant veto ASAP: sales needs API so enterprise customers can opt-out per-tenant before we hit beta. Also need templated customer comms.
rita: Agreed. API contract sketch: POST /v1/tenants/:id/flags {"opt_out": true, "reason": "performance"} — should be idempotent and audited. Sales will publish link to opt-out UI.
ops-bot: automation: will add rollback automation using runbook policy id `rb-micro-2025`. Rollback condition: 2 windows of any gate. Will pause and notify on-call.
sam: Need fallback stacks: primary fast-route -> fallback quantized -> fallback smaller model -> baseline route. Implement per-region circuit-breaker and per-tenant priority queuing so we avoid shedding paid high-priority tenants.
josh: Also add synthetic heartbeat probes per region and per slice firing every 30s. If synthetic p95 > 400ms for 3 probes, trigger pre-emptive throttle (reduce pct by half).
rita: Operator commands we'll support:
```
/rollout create micro-surge --staircase=shadow,internal,beta,regional,global --id=micro-2025-02
/rollout set micro-2025-02 --slice=beta --pct=2
/rollout pause micro-2025-02 --reason="latency spike"
```
Make sure metrics include tags: rollout_id, slice, tenant_id, model_variant.
sales-liaison: For customer comms, we need to state: opt-out available, expected perf delta, and SLA unchanged unless customer opts in. Draft due by EOD.
rita: Timeline: today afternoon lock slices and create rollout object; tomorrow morning start 48h shadowing; target next Wed to begin beta for 5 tenants. Owners: rita (product), sam (implementation + fallback), josh (telemetry + synths), sales-liaison (customer comms).
ops-bot: dry-run scheduled: 2025-03-02T14:00:00Z. Will post rollout_id and dry-run report when complete.
sam: One more: add cost-safety backstop that will automatically scale down pct if cost_per_minute across rollout > baseline*1.25 for 10m.
rita: Great. If no blocking concerns, we'll proceed to lock and spin up the canary dashboard. Ack here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
